entries.description: Private land owned by one lesbian woman welcoming women and children. Offers camping space, woods, and farm land. Emphasizes substance-free ("Drugs in moderation are fine").
entries.raw_text: JAN F WALSH Two Towers, 201 S 132nd Ave, Shelby, MI 49455 (616)861-4939. I own a farm, live on it and work it somewhat. I raise animals and have a .1 acre garden. I welcome visitors, especially lesbians as I am quite isolated, but I do not forbid males of any age access IF known to me or with wimmin. There is camping space galore. If the visit is over 1 night I ask for a $2 fee (I trade)/night per person to defray my costs (water, toilet paper, produce, etc). Drugs in moderation are fine. No proselytizing please. Extended visits (over 1 week) needs to be decided in person. I welcome: girl and boy children, nonlesbian women, (males). I have/am: 1 lesbian, 40 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing (cold running water only)/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land.
entries.notes: Type is Private/Individual Land because Jan F Walsh owns the farm herself ("I own a farm, live on it"). Acreage is 40. Resident count is 1 lesbian. Accepted groups include Lesbian women (implied by directory and welcome text), Non-lesbian women ("nonlesbian women"), Girl children ("girl... children"), Boy children ("boy children"). Males are mentioned ("males of any age access IF known to me or with wimmin"), but per 1982 rules males are not coded unless welcomed in the general welcome list or context; here the welcome list says "(males)" in parentheses with conditions, but as per codebook males are not coded in 1982 unless explicitly welcomed without heavy restriction. Focus on Recovery/substance-free is not present (drugs in moderation allowed). Environmentalism/eco-friendly not coded as chemical-free is not stated.

entries.description: An intentional community in West Central Wisconsin owning 80 acres of land. Four women live year-round, more in summer. Offers a chemical-free space, campground, orchard, garden, housing, plumbing, and electricity, welcoming new members, non-lesbian women, and children.
entries.raw_text: WISCONSIN WOMYN'S LAND CO-OP Rt 2 Box 42, Norwalk, WI 54648 (608)269-5301. WWLC owns DOE (Daughters of Earth) Farm; half wooded campground, half hayfield, orchard, garden, berries, etc in West Central Wisconsin. The land is hilly, secluded, very beautiful. Four womyn live here year 'round, more in summer. Some of the campground chemical free space. Camping equipment available if needed. Sliding scale fees. We welcome: new members/residents, girl children, boy children 'til age of 2, nonlesbian women. We have/are: 175 members almost all lesbians, 80 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative ("WWLC owns", "Four womyn live here year 'round", "We welcome: new members/residents"). Acreage is 80 (choosing the smaller of 175 members vs 80 acres, wait, 175 is members, 80 is acreage). Num residents is 4 ("Four womyn live here year 'round"). Accepted groups: Lesbian women (implied), Non-lesbian women ("nonlesbian women"), Girl children ("girl children"), Boy children ("boy children 'til age of 2"). Focus on Environmentalism/eco-friendly because of "Chemically free, no pets".

entries.description: An intentional community consciously creating a lesbian space with primitive camping. Two lesbians live on 80 acres. Welcomes girl and boy children by arrangement and differently abled women.
entries.raw_text: THE WEB c/o Lanning, Box 8742, Minneapolis, MN 55408 (612)983-2289. We are consciously creating a space in which to live our lesbian reality in harmony with the natural world. Primitive camping here is open to wimmin. We hope to build a community focused on interdependent care toward the healing and health of us all. Chemically free, no pets, no guns, no men. We welcome: girl and boy children by arrangement, differently abled. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 80 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/ electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative ("consciously creating a space... to build a community"). Acreage is 80. Resident count is 2 lesbians. Accepted groups: Lesbian women (implied), Girl children ("girl... children by arrangement"), Boy children ("boy children by arrangement"). Non-lesbian women is not mentioned or welcomed specifically ("open to wimmin", "lesbian reality"). Focus: "differently abled" is mentioned, which maps to Disabled women focus ("Disabled women: Centers disabled women or accessibility"), let's include Disabled women focus.

entries.description: A vacation ranch and social alternative providing tipi lodgings and campsites, some weeks for womyn only. Two lesbians live on 40 acres. Welcomes girl and boy children and gay men.
entries.raw_text: NORTH CROW VACATION RANCH RR 1, Box 62-A, Ronan, MT 59864 (406)676-5169. A new social alternative for lesbians and gay men on holiday. Tipi lodgings ($11/night) or campsite ($7/night). Some weeks are for womyn only. We provide food service ($11/night), hot tub, sports facilities, firewood and basic conveniences. Close by: swimming, boating, etc. Reservations preferred. We welcome: girl and boy children, gay men. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 40 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Retreat/Gathering Space because it is a "vacation ranch" and "social alternative for lesbians and gay men on holiday". Acreage is 40. Residents: 2 lesbians. Accepted groups: Lesbian women (implied), Girl children ("girl... children"), Boy children ("boy children"), Gay men ("gay men"). Non-gay men is not explicitly welcomed ("gay men" is welcomed, but not non-gay men).

entries.description: An intentional community of four women owning 90 acres of land with woods, meadows, and rocky bluffs. Emphasizes solar and appropriate technology and nurturing the female principle. Welcomes new members/residents and visiting women.
entries.raw_text: REBECCA, SUSAN, ANNE & MAURINE 4026 Anderson SE, Albuquerque, NM 87108 (505)268-1863. The land is a combination of woods, meadows, and rocky bluffs. We have a creek and springs. Long-term plans include: cabins for our personal use, additional cabins and camping sites for use by visiting women (by pre-arrangement only), and some farming. Emphasis on solar and appropriate technology and on developing a place that nurtures the female principle. We welcome: new members/res- ident. We have/are: 4 lesbians, 90 acres, camping space, woods.
entries.notes: Community name uses the opening names as printed. Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative (group of four women planning cabins and farming, welcoming new members/residents). Acreage is 90. Residents: 4 lesbians. Accepted groups: Lesbian women (implied), Non-lesbian women (visiting women by pre-arrangement, new members/resident). Focus on Environmentalism/eco-friendly ("Emphasis on solar and appropriate technology").

entries.description: An intentional community collective seeking new members. Located 2 hours north of San Francisco on 167 acres of woods, meadows, and farm land. Welcomes new members and loans.
entries.raw_text: YORKVILLE WOMEN'S LAND COLLECTIVE c/o Annie, 50 Balmy, San Francisco, CA 94110 (415)285-5145. YWLC seeking 2 lesbian-feminists for new group. Old group (save one) needs to sell. Lots of land 2 hours north of SF. Needs committment, money and respect. Into building living space, relationship, feminism. Not into drug abuse or S&M. Send name, address and phone for full details. Issues & money still negotiable. We welcome: new members, loans. We have/are: 6 lesbians, 167 acres, camping space, woods and meadows, farm land (grazing).
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative ("YWLC seeking 2 lesbian-feminists for new group", "women's land collective"). Acreage is 167. Residents: 6 lesbians. Accepted groups: Lesbian women (implied), Non-lesbian women ("new members" general). Recovery/substance-free is not a focus since it says "Not into drug abuse" but doesn't make it a defining sobriety rule in the required sense, or maybe it does? Codebook says: "Sobriety, 12-step, or drug/alcohol-free as a defining rule of the place." Let's leave focuses empty as it's just a preference ("Not into drug abuse").

entries.description: Privately owned woman's land operating as a ranch open to camping and events. Offers 500 acres with housing for workers, plumbing, outhouses, camping space, woods, and farm land. Welcomes new members, children under 10, and non-lesbian women.
entries.raw_text: THE RANCH c/o Helen Wagner, 440 Holladay, San Francisco, CA 94110 (415)824-5352. Privately Woman owned land open to camping and events June-Sept. Horses boarded, workers welcomed. Daily and weekly rates and special event rates $5/day and up. We welcome: new members, girl children, boy children under 10, nonlesbian women, dogs, horses. We have/are: 500 acres, housing/permanent structures limited to workers, plumbing, outhouses, camping space, woods, farm land, cook out grills, creek on land, near Russian River, women living and working on the land.

entries.description: A women's community and retreat 3 hours north of San Francisco on 160 acres of redwood-covered slopes and meadows. Features multiple structures including a communal kitchen and guesthouse. Began as an older women's community, seeking permanent members especially lesbians over 50.
entries.raw_text: LAVENDER HILL 1085 Greenwood Rd, Elk, AC 95432. A thriving womyn's community and retreat located 3 hours north of SF and close to the ocean. 160 acres of redwood-covered slopes, open grassy meadows, waterfalls, and pools for reflection. Nine structures including a communal kitchen, guesthouse, and bath house, look out over surrounding valleys and hills. A vegetable and flower garden, an herb garden, and an orchard. We began as an older womyn's community. We are now womyn of diverse ages, races and backgrounds, looking for permanent members (especially lesbians over 50). Visitors $5/night (exceptions: working class/older/third world women). We welcome: new members/residents, girl children, nonlesbian women (possibly). We have/are: 8 lesbians, 60 acknowledges [60 acres], 10 housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity with generator, camping space, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: State corrected from AC to CA ("Elk, AC 95432"). Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative ("womyn's community and retreat" - community named first). Acreage is 60 (listing says "60, 60 acres, ... wait, text says '60 acres' in the questionnaire part after '8 lesbians, 60 acres' though earlier it said '160 acres of redwood-covered slopes'. Codebook rule: 'If the listing gives two different figures, store the smaller and note both.' Smaller is 60, larger is 160). Residents: 8 lesbians. Accepted groups: Lesbian women (implied), Non-lesbian women ("nonlesbian women (possibly)"), Girl children ("girl children"). Focus on Older women ("We began as an older womyn's community", seeking lesbians over 50).
